title: Say it your way
caption: Waypoint speaks sixteen languages. Mira says hello in six of them.
linkedin_text:
Most people think in a language other than the one their apps speak.

Waypoint works in 16 languages, shows its own words in the one you pick, and can translate a post with one tap. Mira says hello in six of them; every screen is the real app in that language.
